# Sandbox target files

Copy these into the throwaway target repository (see [docs/first-run-mobile.md](../../../../docs/first-run-mobile.md)):

| File here | Place in the target | Edit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `forge.yml` | `.github/workflows/forge.yml` | Replace `<TAG-OR-SHA>` in both places with the engine commit SHA |
| `issue.md` | Not a file: its text is the first issue | Paste it into a new issue |
